requirements.title: Concept reservations are scoped and cannot be silently reused
requirements.remaining: The concept reservation authority lives in this repository and the concept commands now resolve it at its real location (tests/test_concept_actions.py); before this fix they refused every call with an import error. Remaining: construct a live default authority from a connected graph engine, so reservations work without explicit injection.

Cleanup removes isolated checkouts and scratch only after merge
requirements.remaining: Containment-before-delete for worktree/branch is implemented and tested, but no host-local build-scratch removal, uv-cache-prune step, or distinct 'cleanup run log' artifact was found in repository-manager's own code.

requirements.title: Workspace check refuses credential-embedded remote URLs
requirements.remaining: Cloning refuses a remote URL that embeds a username or token, and redacts it in the refusal (tests/test_repository_manager.py). Remaining: a workspace check over the remotes of managed checkouts, stripping embedded credentials from remotes this package manages, and the test that managed checkouts contain none.
